lines: A. Venkatachalam, Investor Selling Shareholder, sells 408,469 shares in the offer for sale, so money is coming to them.
Proceeds of ₹6.17 crore arrive on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹5.80 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained pre-offer shares are subject to a 6-month lock-in from allotment.
Unknown: pre-offer holding not confirmed from the documents, so the retained stake cannot be sized yet.
